disposition.target: Recovery Workbench Service Template Specification v1 (naming table, P3 row rwb-case, Java package)
disposition.change: Rule the package segment for the P3 row rwb-case so the Java package no longer uses the reserved word 'case', and publish the ruled package; the story copies it in sections 1 and 13.
disposition.note: The naming rule the item cites carries the same package at Service Template Specification v1 L371; the segment is ruled there, then copied here. No name invented.
Size row added to the story metadata table; the value is set by the squad at refinement, no number invented (the item gives none).
Section 15 already gives empty, loading, error and no-access for SCR-02, SCR-03 and SCR-05; the open states carry CG-ALL-3562 to CG-ALL-3564.
Section 17 names the fields the story carries and defers any personal-data class to the data model and the rwb-access masking rules of section 10; no field invented.
No source excerpt gives the next number of rwb-case's V0001..Vnnnn sequence; section 13 now names the file by the DP-15 sequence rule instead of V1021_1.

edits.old: - No personal data in logs, tests, workflow history, event payloads or prompts; the workflow payload codec of the kit encrypts every payload.
edits.new: - No personal data in logs, tests, workflow history, event payloads or prompts; the workflow payload codec of the kit encrypts every payload. The fields this story carries are the case ID, queue, team, owner user ID, reason code, rule ID and package version; any of them that the data model classes as personal data is masked under the rwb-access masking rules and kept out of prompts (DOR-RWB-P3-E1021-APP-11).

edits.new: - Migration in this story, in the per-service Flyway sequence of DP-15: `V<next number>__transfer.sql`, taking the next free number of `rwb-case`'s own V0001 to Vnnnn sequence (not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-3561)), adds `recovery_case.status_before_hold`, `assignment.transfer_reason_code`, the partial unique index and `processed_event` (event_id uuid primary key, consumer varchar(60), processed_at).
